name: Rain Window
desc: Rain on the window of a moving vehicle at night — beads cling and vibrate then release into wind-sheared streaks, while big soft passing-light bokeh smears slide across a fogged pane; a cinematic night-drive glass over any scene.

shear.doc: streak lean from vehicle motion (0.5=straight down)

style.doc: night_drive=dark, sodium+white bokeh / day_bus=grey overcast / neon_city=magenta-cyan bokeh / noir=high-contrast mono
